svg.title: The diffusion kernel from the Gray-Scott model
svg.desc: A 3 by 3 kernel: each square sends 20 percent (times a rate) of its contents to each side neighbor and 5 percent to each corner neighbor, keeping the rest. Applied over and over, a spike of oxygen spreads into a smooth blob while the total stays the same.
svg.text: from the Gray–Scott model in my programming class
